title: FRC - First Robotics
body:
In high school I began participating in First Robotics on team 3546, Buc'n'gears, as a way to learn more about coding as well as gain experience working with a team of individuals. This was an incredibly valuable experience as It gave me an opportunity to work with people from many different fields and was one of my first experiences working on a technical project with other individuals.

In my time with First Robotics I worked on the programming and electrical where I worked to develop the robot code in Java and wired the robot. In this time I learned a significant amount about methods and classes. It also taught me a significant amount about the value of team work and how to work on a team

By the time I graduated from the program I had also worked my way up to being the co-captain of our team, where I led the programming and electrical components of the robot.
